description: One-Click Apps (Coolify apps such as Pterodactyl, Nextcloud, n8n, Uptime Kuma) on a dedicated server: setup status, installed apps with status and access URL, whether apps can be installed. No passwords are returned. live=true asks the panel for the current status. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

live.description: Ask the panel for the live status (slower; needs the manage permission), default the stored status.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_dedicated_apps
title: List Dedicated Server One-Click Apps
